shortDescription: Sets or updates configuration attributes on HPE iLO with Redfish OEM extensions

options.name: attribute_name
options.description: Name of the attribute to be configured.

options.name: attribute_value
options.description: Value of the attribute to be configured.

options.name: category
options.description: Command category to execute on iLO.

options.name: command
options.description: List of commands to execute on iLO.

options.name: componentsig
options.description: Component signature file path needed by iLO to authenticate the component file. If not provided, the command will try to find the signature file from component file path.

options.name: force
options.description: Add this flag to force upload components with the same name already on the repository.

options.name: fwpkg_file
options.description: Absolute path of the firmware package file that the user wishes to attach.

options.name: install_filename
options.description: Name of the file package that needs to be installed.

options.name: overwrite
options.description: Permission to overwrite a file present of the server with same name.

options.name: remote
options.description: Remote file path where the file is present.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for HTTP requests to iLO.

options.name: tover
options.description: Use this flag if the server you are currently logged into has a TPM chip installed.

options.name: update_srs
options.description: The component uploaded will become a part of the system recovery set (srs).
